title: Encoded and non-genetic protein variants expand the human functional proteome
title_zh: 编码与非遗传蛋白质变体扩展了人类功能组学
abstract: Each stage of the central dogma contributes to proteome diversity through mechanisms such as heterozygosity, somatic mutations, transcriptional errors and translational errors. As a result, a diverse array of protein variants can coexist within a single proteome, such as that of humans. However, until now, methods to detect, quantify and evaluate the functional consequences of these variants have been lacking. Here we examine a large-scale proteogenomic dataset from 29 healthy human tissues and identify 13,910 confidently localized variants representing 7,215 unique single amino acid substitutions co-existing alongside their corresponding reference proteoforms1. We find that the abundance of both |genetic (single-nucleotide polymorphisms, somatic mutations) and mistranslated protein variants mirrors their allele frequencies in the human population. Moreover, we show that non-genetic substitutions may provide a distinct route for exploring protein sequence space, circumventing the mutational constraints imposed by the genetic code. We also provide experimental validation of non-genetic substitution in selected purified proteins. We demonstrate specific and recurring non-genetic variation patterns after amino acid starvation in proteome-wide analyses of cancer-derived cell lines and identify hundreds of substituted non-genetic proteoforms that recur consistently in multiple healthy individuals or map to annotated protein functional sites. We propose that these substitutions constitute a previously undescribed class of functional protein phenotypic variants. Collectively, our findings indicate that non-genetic amino acid substitutions in human proteins provide an abundant source for expanding the functional proteome.
abstract_zh: 中央教条的每个阶段通过异质性、体细胞突变、转录错误和翻译错误等机制促进组学多样性。结果，一系列蛋白质变体可以在单一组学中共存，如人类组学。然而，迄今为止，缺乏检测、量化和评估这些变体功能后果的方法。在此，我们利用来自29种健康人体组织的大规模蛋白质组学-基因组学数据集，鉴定出13,910个可靠定位的变体，代表7,215个独特的单氨基酸替换，它们与其对应的参考蛋白质共存。我们发现，遗传变体（单核苷酸多态性、体细胞突变）和错译蛋白质变体的丰度与人类种群中的等位基因频率相匹配。此外，我们表明，非遗传替换提供了一条独特的途径，在绕过遗传密码施加的突变限制的同时，探索蛋白质序列空间。我们还提供了选定纯化蛋白质的非遗传替换实验验证。我们演示了在癌细胞系的组学-wide分析中，氨基酸饥饿后特定且反复出现的非遗传变异模式，并鉴定出数百个在多个健康个体中反复出现或映射到标记蛋白质功能位点的非遗传蛋白质变体。我们提议，这些替换构成了一类此前未被描述的功能蛋白质表型变体。综合我们的发现表明，人类蛋白质中的非遗传氨基酸替换为扩展功能组学提供了丰富的来源。
